summary: Phase 3 passes at 4f53364. Every gate reproduces at the audited HEAD. An independent recompute from runs/ matches all 112 published cells and the original 34-run golden preview. No blocking finding exists. Five nonblocking record or gate findings remain.
nonblocking_findings: PA-P3-1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Record the late findings before closeout. plan.md holds no `Late finding <id>:` line. Tasks 3.6 and 3.7 hold one summary line each, and A-P3-9 has no line. Root tech-debt.md holds none of A-P3-3 to A-P3-7, A-P3-9, ADV-P3-1 to ADV-P3-8, or UX-P3-1 to UX-P3-11. The path measure/tech-debt.md does not exist. Fix: add one plan line and one tech-debt entry for each finding. Score-impact: no.

PA-P3-2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The preview refresh left old counts in four places. plan.md:82 (task 1.1 Verify) says `prints 34`, and the command now prints 58. test-strategy.md:302-303 gives 34 runs, 49 safe, 32 risk, and 17 unproven; the preview now has 58 runs with 51 safe, 33 risk, 14 unoptimized, and 14 unproven. spec.md:81 (EV5) and the `evidence` field of metadata.json still describe the 34-run preview. Fix: update or date-stamp each line before final acceptance. Score-impact: no.

PA-P3-3 [Major] phase-acceptance: No standing gate runs the adversarial file. TRUST_TEST (plan.md:36) runs only site-tests/domain-trust.test.ts. The 48 cases of site-tests/domain-trust-adversarial.test.ts hold the regression tests for A-P3-1 and A-P3-8 and the FR-1 drift guards. No npm script, plan gate, or task 4.3 runs them. Task 3.6 Verify says `TRUST_TEST exits 0 with the added cases`, and the literal command omits them. The file also needs commit 6a237be reachable (lines 29 and 1298). ADV-P3-1 shares this cause. Fix: before task 4.3, set TRUST_TEST to both files. Score-impact: no today.

PA-P3-4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Some plan evidence has no command. Tasks 3.2 and 3.3 quote PAGE_DESCRIBE_CHECK=pass, AFFECTED_CELLS=17, COVERAGE_LABELS=251, PARTIAL_NO_BLOCK=true, and PARTIAL_BYTE_IDENTICAL=true without the command (test-strategy.md section 11, A5). Task 3.4 records only the aggregate work-list line, so no one can compare per-row classes. I reproduced each claim with committed tests or a recount. Fix: record the command next to each labeled line. Score-impact: no.

PA-P3-5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Two Phase 4 gate details need a fix. (a) The 4.1 O1 Verify regex needs the text `| 2 2026-10-25`, and the spec cell reads `2, approved by the owner 2026-10-25`, so the command prints 0 lines today. (b) PI_SHA depends on the sort locale: LC_ALL=C gives aa8b2421b629487089da8af9310cf31eb597f193cff15cf1e3a4844d70efd8fe, and en_US.UTF-8 gives the base value 7af106ad.... Run `PI_SHA merged` in the same locale as `base`. Fix: pin the locale in the plan command. Score-impact: no.
